decisions.reason: As a wood-floor cleaning soap fully aligned with the firm's existing care portfolio, and upgraded from a mention to its own page by 2024, it fits the firm's knowledge base and shows enough traction to justify continued support.

Maintenance oil draws directly on the firm's established expertise in wooden floor treatment, but its remaining only a website mention in 2024 suggests weaker market pull than the more prominently featured care products.

A care product for oiled wood floors is highly complementary to the firm's core flooring systems, and the move to a dedicated page in 2024 indicates the firm has learned enough from early sales to continue developing it.

A moisture-protection underlay is closely tied to the firm's installation system knowledge and supports bundle sales, though its limited website prominence implies somewhat higher pruning risk than the flagship care items.

High-density underlay foam is still related to the firm's flooring capabilities, but as a more standard accessory with no rise in visibility by 2024 it faces the highest risk of rationalisation within an otherwise healthy portfolio.

Oak parquet is very close to the firm's core product and manufacturing know-how, so even without stronger website emphasis the firm's absorptive capacity and growing market conditions make continuation likely.
